assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original transparent character illustration for a children's memory-journal website. Design a unique, friendly little grey mouse mascot with a rounded pear-shaped body, soft medium grey fur, large circular warm-pink ears, tiny charcoal nose, a few fine whiskers, and a distinctive small sage-green crossbody satchel. The mouse is happily holding a small cream notebook and a pencil, sitting amid two subtle paper stars. Loosely hand-drawn dark charcoal outlines and matte colored-pencil / gouache texture, charming modern picture-book aesthetic. Full body with ample padding, centered, facing slightly left. Colors: grey #B6B6BA, pink #F4AABB, cream #FFF8F4, sage #E6EDD9. True transparent background, no solid backdrop, no border. No typography, logo, watermark, other characters. This is a new original character and must not reproduce any existing trademarked character or specific recognizable IP.
